scope: Immutable profile ablations in fresh Fortress physics worlds; physical robot never commanded.

measurement.heading_velocity: Independent time integration of truth world-position differences after yaw-only heading rotation.
measurement.height_rmse: Time-weighted piecewise-linear truth height error relative to 0.34 m.
measurement.steady_window: Last 2 s only if the full configured motion-stage duration completed without a prior controller safety fault. Each phase stores its actual requested and elapsed duration.
measurement.fault_timing: Controller log wall timestamps mapped through adjacent diagnostics arrival timestamps; this mapping is approximate. Conservative pre-fault cutoff uses earlier diagnostic stamp.
measurement.mode_lag: Kinematics mode labels reuse throttled diagnostics and may lag FAULT. Post-fault falling samples are not treated as active-support height error.
measurement.motor_log: The first motor threshold warning identifies one physics-step request; it may differ from the sample that triggers controller SafetyMonitor.
measurement.execution_effort_thresholds: Motor WARN uses 1.10 times URDF effort limits (hip/thigh26.07Nm, calf49.5Nm); no threshold excursion does not prove requests always remain below nominal limits or a calibrated real motor saturation bound.

limitations: Short stages and a small number of repeats cannot establish an endurance limit or safe physical-robot speed.
IMU rate, delay and friction are imposed simulation assumptions, not identified hardware models.
Simulated effort is motor-PD requested joint torque, not calibrated physical torque or foot force.
Controller-input budgets reconstructed at approximately 10 Hz can miss execution-time and physics-step peaks.

Geometric stability without a controller fault is reported separately from absence of a 1 kHz motor-request effort-threshold crossing; 500 Hz SafetyMonitor may miss a short crossing logged by the motor model.
Only fully completed movement stages receive steady velocity/height metrics; failed or unreached targets are not assigned steady performance.
Source and effective-control-input hashes must remain unchanged within each trial; compare library hashes before comparing builds.

experiment_design.sequence: A baseline -> B lower motion Kp -> C height PD -> D base task weight -> E Qzz -> F upstream-style joint PD -> G isolated lower Kd -> high-side probes and E long repeats. D missing primary cases were completed after long repeats, using identical control libraries.
experiment_design.independent_ablation: C, D and E each change a single parameter group relative to B; they are not cumulative. F changes only motion joint PD relative to A. G changes only motion Kd relative to B. Stand-up and settling stay60/60/90 Kd2.
experiment_design.small_sample_caution: Each fixed primary case is one run per profile. E alone has a second, longer run for selected cases. Fractions describe observed coverage, not statistical success probabilities.

grouped_results.scope: Completed simulation probes only. Fixed-set six-second comparisons, appended side-speed probes and long repeats have separate denominators.

definitions.strong_stability: Full probe completes, geometric bounds hold, no controller safety fault and no 1kHz motor request above1.10×URDF effort.
definitions.full_acceptance: Strong stability plus the unchanged strict commanded/governed-reference tracking checks.
definitions.repeat_preservation: Every repeat remains a separate record. A later failure never overwrites an earlier short success.
definitions.steady_metrics: Last2s only for a completed requested motion stage. Failure during later stopping/stance can coexist with completed movement metrics.

reproducibility.raw_logs_policy: Large raw physics/diagnostic logs and generated experiment profiles remain local under ignored log/. This JSON preserves compact numerical evidence, parameter snapshots and hashes; it does not embed every raw trace.

independent_evidence_audit.scope_note: Evidence/loaded-profile/cleanup integrity checks only; does not convert failing physical probes into acceptance.

primary_sources.supports: Kt0.63895,maximumphasecurrent40A,6.33reduction,maximumoutputtorque23.7Nm; does not explicitly define Kt shaft/current convention
SDK setpoints/feedback rotor-side SI coordinates; SDK accepts Nm and internal gains, not user current commands
Upstream motion joint Kp0 Kd3 plus WBC torque; local WBC still contains state feedback

torque_constant_review.user_confirmation: User is unsure which shaft and requested manufacturer verification
torque_constant_review.verified_status: Manufacturer numerical value confirmed; Kt shaft/current definition not established by retrieved manufacturer documents

conditional_output_shaft_interpretation.assumption: Kt is equivalent torque per phase current at the built-in6.33 gearbox output; ideal extra2:1 calf stage, losses ignored; not calibrated

torque_constant_review.software_effect: No extra Kt multiplication/division introduced; existing joint torque/gear Nm SDK conversion and gain/gear^2 conversion preserved
limitations: Input DC battery current must not be substituted for phase/iq current
Kt alone does not establish continuous current, thermal limit, torque-speed envelope or physical effort calibration
No hardware IO or motion performed
torque_constant_review.upstream_low_level_control: Kp0 removes the additional low-level joint-position spring. WBC remains model/state feedback and Kd3 tracks dq_des-dq; it is not generally -3*dq or fully open-loop.

manufacturer_definition_review.conclusion: 公开取得的厂家官网、厂家V1.0手册、官方SDK说明及相关官方文档/issue检索，仅确认数值，不能明确Kt轴侧或iq/相电流/峰值/RMS口径。
manufacturer_definition_review.manual_authorship: Unitree GO-M8010-6 Motor Data User Manual V1.0, manufacturer-authored document hosted by a distributor
manufacturer_definition_review.manual_limitation: Torque constant table does not define shaft/current convention. Curve current is Input DC Current, not an iq calibration.

interpretation_zh: 没有获得全方向高速、可重复通过的参数组。E的首轮4工况通过不能覆盖第二轮左右0.30m/s约2s就触发力矩保护的失败。不能把失败描述成仅仅长时间运行后出现。
后退时低机身高度独立于故障存在：E第二轮20s末2s平均约0.3175m，名义0.34m仍差约22.5mm。
相对B，单独增大WBC高度PD或机身任务权重，没有明显恢复后退机身高度；Qzz1500->2000首轮仅毫米量级变化，小样本不能作显著性或唯一根因结论。baseAccel是6维任务，权重仍可能改善其他方向协调。
已捕获执行力矩由FF、P、D共同组成且命令年龄约21ms。0/3方案右移0.30m/s在P为0时，FF约15.44+D约10.76=26.20Nm，超过26.07Nm保护门限；不能仅靠消除Kp保证不超限。
WBC的前馈字段包含基于状态的任务空间反馈与逆动力学结果，Kp0不是取消所有位置反馈；Kd3乘目标关节速度与实测速度的差，并非永远是-3*dq。
WBC QP仅约束前馈力矩，之后叠加电机PD。发送时的预算缩放使用当时反馈，无法保证延迟后执行时的FF+PD仍在预算内。当前模型没有经标定的连续电流/力矩饱和，日志记录请求力矩，不能把26Nm请求解释为真实电机已输出26Nm。
高度日志区分名义参考、当前评估策略状态、WBC目标与QP预测az。当前评估策略状态受初始状态锚定，不能仅凭它偏低就认定NMPC主动选择低高度；QP残差小也不能证明真实执行加速度正确。
后续优先核对延迟执行下的总力矩预算、目标关节速度连续性和模型/接触/状态估计一致性，再在已留出力矩余量的范围内调整高度目标与权重。不要放宽保护阈值来获得表面通过，也不建议据这些结果直接把真机改成0/3。
公共控制参数保持原请求的60/60/90、Kd2；候选只用于独立仿真。没有真机起身或行走，没有提交或推送。
